analysis_unit: single-cell lineage trajectory within one channel

populations.observation_grain: one detected cell per (FOV, channel, time point)
exclusions: spine_length < min_spine_length removed before lineage linking (1.0.0)

metrics.SPINE_LENGTH: spine_length (um), calibrated upstream before CSV export
metrics.GENERATION_TIME: division_time[1, :] (h), diff of consecutive division times
metrics.GROWTH_RATE_CYC: growth_rate[1, :] (1/h), centered-time OLS slope of ln(spine_length) per cycle using finite positive lengths

min_spine_length.ui_widget: float slider with adjustable min/max bounds

statistics.per_cycle_fit: OLS via numpy.polyfit deg 1 full=True on ln(spine_length) vs time minus first valid time; rank 2 and finite coefficients required
statistics.ordering: defensive numeric-time/length copy, stable ascending time; input unchanged
statistics.segments: split immediately after division-mother rows; nonfinite-time rows omitted with RuntimeWarning; invalid lengths retained
statistics.fit_observations: at least 4 finite times with finite positive lengths; invalid observations warn with RuntimeWarning
statistics.degenerate: fewer than 4 valid observations -> NaNs; no time variation -> RuntimeWarning and NaNs; constant length -> slope 0 and NaN R^2
statistics.r_squared: 1 - sum(residual^2) / sum((log_length - mean(log_length))^2), explicit residual calculation
statistics.numerical_failures: expected numerical failures, deficient rank or nonfinite coefficients -> RuntimeWarning and NaNs; no broad exception swallow

rules.division: 0 <= (L_a + L_b) - L_0 < division_threshold * L_0 and L_a < 0.9 * L_0
rules.tracing: count more than one non-self child before the root self-edge stop
rules.trajectory_order: get_one_trajectory returns a stable ascending-time_h trajectory
rules.upstream_units: length and width already um; area already um^2; time_s seconds; no length rescaling
rules.reconstruction: Process Data required for new lineage rules; old annotations are not migrated

plots.TRAJ_VIEWER: spine_length (log y) vs time_h, per-cycle segments

validation_gates: no trajectory row with spine_length < min_spine_length when filter active
fully filtered channel returns None without error
sidebar parameter reaches process_channel_worker on Process Data
founder with two non-self children counted once; root plus one continuation not a division
exact conservation accepted; negative difference and equality to either strict upper bound rejected
fresh UI seconds default; all supported time units convert correctly; invalid time_unit raises ValueError
sorted numeric-time copies preserve input and recover known exponential slopes
nonfinite times omitted from segments; invalid lengths retained but excluded from fits with RuntimeWarning
insufficient observations, repeated times, constant lengths and numerical fit failures follow declared NaN/warning policy
app statistics schema 2 invalidates stale statistics; sorted trajectory returned

evidence.scope: Defaults/versions introspected; rule narrative reviewed; regression tests not executed by this exporter
evidence.regression_results: Not collected by exporter; see R002 reconciliation and Lead validation
